prompts: The game went down in June and we owe the team an incident report. The logs and their notes are in {WS}/logs. When did it start and end, how long was it, did we keep our monthly availability target, and why did it happen? Record it in {WS}/result.json: start, end, minutes_down, availability_june_pct, slo_999_ok, root_cause.
answers:
[goal] Record the June incident in [result.json](<WORKSPACE>/result.json).

[action] Used the notes’ definition of downtime, from the first save error to server readiness, and assumed the timestamps share a timezone; none is specified.

[result] The outage ran from 2026-06-02 03:17:42 to 03:53:31, lasting 35 minutes 49 seconds. June availability was 99.917091%, so the 99.9% target was met. The logs report “No space left on device” for the save and later “server ready, accepting players.” Backup rotation freed 38.2 GB before recovery. The logs do not establish why the disk filled.

[next] None.
